title: How to tell a story with Meta Ads
description: How to tell a story with Meta Ads
transcript: This is how you tell a story with meta ads. You can set your ads to be delivered in a sequence and educate your audience in any way you wish. For example, if I'm selling a high ticket offer, I'm going to start by delivering value. Then I'm going to demonstrate how the product or service works.
